testPolicy.text: Northwestern is test-optional and does not require ACT or SAT scores from first-year or transfer candidates. Applying without an SAT or ACT score will not impact the review or chances of admission. Scores may be self-reported; admitted students who included scores must send official scores before matriculation. CDS 2025-26 C8 lists SAT or ACT as 'not required for admission, considered if submitted' for Fall 2027.

cost.totalIncludes: on-campus estimate: tuition 71,802 + fees 1,260 + on-campus housing and meals 22,941 (direct, billed) + books and supplies 1,239 + personal expenses 2,079 + loan fees 54 = 99,375. Transportation is listed as 'varies' and is not in the total.

aidPromise.text: Most families making less than $150K per year attend Northwestern tuition-free. Northwestern meets 100% of demonstrated need with scholarships, grants and work-study, without loans (loan-free policy). Aid is strictly need-based.
aidPromise.year: current policy as published in 2026 (year of start not stated on the page)

facts.text: Early Decision admitted 1,212 of 5,939 applicants for fall 2025 (about 20%), against 3,933 of 52,676 overall (about 7.5%); ED admits were about 31% of all admits.
Northwestern has a single binding Early Decision round (November 1) and Regular Decision (January 4); there is no Early Action and no Early Decision II.
Most families earning under $150,000 a year attend tuition-free, and need is met without loans.
The 2026-27 on-campus cost of attendance is $99,375 before transportation, with tuition of $71,802 billed by the quarter.
Testing stays optional for fall 2027 applicants; 48% of fall 2025 entrants submitted the SAT (middle 50% 1520-1560).
167 students were admitted from the waiting list for fall 2025.

notes: CDS 2025-26 opened and read (C1, C2, C8, C9, C21, C22, G1, G5). Northwestern did not fill C12 (GPA), the C1 residency split, or the number offered a waitlist place.
